name: Hyakkin
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional 100-yen shop, Kirakira 100-yen: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at the register learning the sticker-color pricing, a product price guide, a self-checkout trial notice, a bulk-buy delivery plan comparison, an essay about learning to add a word when handing goods to customers, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to face products on the shelf, an explainer on how the shop's sourcing changed since it began as a small general store, a return and service policy guide, a column on how self-checkout spread and changed customer contact, a new hybrid rule for in-store benefit days by product category, a column on balancing efficiency and face-to-face service, and a one-year report on the benefit-day system. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
